svg.aria-label: Three-dimensional surface of single-domain antibody preference against epitope depth below the convex hull and relative solvent accessibility. Blue regions favour single-domain binders, orange favour conventional Fabs, and the neutral band marks the base rate.
svg.text: Epitope depth and solvent exposure set the shape of the site: and with it, which antibody format has historically reached it.
13,875 interfaces · 1,740 antigen clusters · Gaussian kernel 1.0 Å × 0.050, weighted 1/n per antigen
Pale regions carry little data: depth and exposure correlate at r = −0.44, so deep-and-exposed and shallow-and-buried are nearly empty corners of the space.
